Callout.Name: Suspected Stalker
Callout.Message: Person repeatedly seen watching an address.
Callout.Advisory: Person in a parked car, no offence witnessed yet.

Script.Line: Same man, same car, every morning this week.
He parks across the road and he just sits there.
I have the plate and I have the dates. It is all written down.

Lines.Approach: Third report this week, same car, same spot. They are there now.
Lines.SignOff: Show me 10-8 when you are clear.
